name: Matrimony
overview: Scripture reveals that matrimony is a divine institution established by God at creation, where He made man and woman in His image and blessed them to be fruitful and multiply (Genesis 1:27-28, 9:1). It is designed for companionship, as God recognized that it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). The union is marked by a lifelong commitment where a man leaves his parents to cleave to his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24), a truth reaffirmed by Christ who pointed back to the original creation of male and female (Matthew 19:4).
